subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Can the security/workflow owners approve these fourteen upgraded external action SHAs—especially the Codex, app-token, Docker publishing, and CodeQL actions—after source/release review and exact-head workflow validation?
rationale: This is a deliberate supply-chain trust decision across privileged workflows, not a narrow repository-side code repair that automation can safely choose.

options.title: Validate and merge
options.body: Review the upstream action revisions, rebase onto current main, and require successful affected workflow runs before approving.

options.title: Defer the action group
options.body: Keep the current reviewed pins until the security/workflow owners can complete the upstream trust and runtime review.

recommendation.title: Validate and merge
recommendation.body: Review the upstream action revisions, rebase onto current main, and require successful affected workflow runs before approving.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly routes the changed CodeQL and dependency-guard security workflow paths to this official team.
